scenes.text: Sketch the classroom and locate the teacher’s desk and other objects.
A classroom sketch shows where objects are located using simple shapes. Draw the classroom outline, then mark the teacher’s table (Tt), board (Bb/Wb), cupboard (C) and your seat (Me).
A label or key helps another learner read the sketch. The drawing does not need to be perfectly to scale.
Walk around the class with your teacher and make a labelled bird’s-eye-view sketch.
